verdict.rationale: Convex is a managed reactive database with nothing to set up: `npm create convex@latest` creates a project, and the CLI pushes functions and schema to a cloud dev deployment where tables appear on first insert. Data is read and written through TypeScript query and mutation functions running in the database, with ACID transactions and real-time sync. Clients use those functions from frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue and Svelte, and public functions are also callable over HTTP endpoints for server-side access. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the client SDK APIs and a dedicated server-side or Node SDK (beyond HTTP endpoints and the CLI), and independent hands-on corroboration of provisioning and read/write from both sides.
